menu_host_lock: Starting or loading another farm is off while you are hosting — it would drop everyone who joined.
menu_guest_lock: This farm belongs to the host, so it is theirs to save, load, and download.
menu_fail_unknown_format: The file is in an unknown format.
menu_fail_not_gardena: The file is not a gardena format
menu_fail_version: This savefile is from an older Gardena version and could not be loaded
menu_fail_unusable: The savefile could not be loaded
menu_mp_version: That farm runs a different build of Gardena. Both players need the same version.
menu_mp_full: That farm is full — it already has four gardeners.
menu_mp_busy: The host is letting someone else in. Try again in a moment.
menu_mp_ice: Could not reach that farm. Check the code and that the host is still hosting.
menu_mp_host_left: The host closed the farm. Anything unsaved stayed with them.
menu_mp_lost: Lost the host and could not get back after three tries.
menu_mp_desync: This farm drifted out of step with the host and could not be repaired.
menu_mp_unusable: This farm could not be used.
menu_code_placeholder: paste the code the host gave you
menu_ask_host: Ask the host to press the multiplayer button and copy their code.
menu_host_live: Your farm is open. Share this code and friends can drop in.
menu_host_opening: Opening your farm to the outside world.
menu_copy_fail: Select the code above and press Ctrl+C.
menu_guest_body: You are gardening on someone else’s farm.
